name: ESP32-S3 N16R8, dual LX7 @ 240 MHz, 8 MB OPI PSRAM, 16 MB QIO flash

sources.psram@80/120: esp32-tinyLLM BENCHMARKING.md, 'Is attention's core bandwidth-bound?' dual-core probe table; single-core figure moves 68-81 MB/s with code layout (+-5%)
sources.sram: treated as free: its cost is inside the fitted cycles/MAC
sources.board: Pre-board literature values, kept because the calibration engines were measured by their authors. Our board (docs/phase1-bench.md): PSRAM@80 86.7/89.8 MB/s seq read (PIE int4 stream 73.1/83.4), PSRAM@120 121.8/131.2, 256 B flash row 9.66 us. costmodel/ideas.py applies the board values (MEAS column). The psram@120 1-core figure (81) is a code-layout-sensitive tinyLLM probe, far below our 121.8
